name: Phalanx Duel
description: Local Phalanx Duel browser, server, gameplay, WebSocket, and collector view.

service_map.title: Phalanx Duel service map
service_map.query: SELECT service_name, peer_service, span_name, count(*) AS requests FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND peer_service IS NOT NULL GROUP BY service_name, peer_service, span_name ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.title: Request rate by service
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, service_name, count(*) AS requests FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' GROUP BY time, service_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Errors by service
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, service_name, count(*) AS errors FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND (status_code = 'ERROR' OR level = 'error') GROUP BY time, service_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Gameplay action latency
panels.query: SELECT action_type, count(*) AS actions, round(avg(duration_ms), 2) AS avg_ms, round(max(duration_ms), 2) AS max_ms FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND action_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY action_type ORDER BY actions DESC

panels.title: Match lifecycle
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, event, sum(value) AS matches FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND metric_name = 'match.lifecycle' GROUP BY time, event ORDER BY time

panels.title: WebSocket sessions and reconnects
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, event, count(*) AS events FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND (span_name = 'ws.session' OR event LIKE 'ws.%') GROUP BY time, event ORDER BY time

panels.title: Browser lifecycle and gameplay events
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, event, sum(value) AS events FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND metric_name = 'phx.client.events' GROUP BY time, event ORDER BY time

panels.title: Active matches and WebSocket connections
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, metric_name, max(value) AS value FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND metric_name IN ('system.matches_active', 'system.ws_connections') GROUP BY time, metric_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Golden signal · throughput
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, metric_name, sum(value) AS operations FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND metric_name IN ('system.actions_total', 'game.action.results', 'match.lifecycle') GROUP BY time, metric_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Golden signal · errors
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, metric_name, sum(value) AS errors FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND (metric_name = 'slo.violations' OR status_code = 'ERROR' OR level = 'error') GROUP BY time, metric_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Golden signal · latency distributions
panels.query: SELECT metric_name, round(avg(value), 2) AS avg_ms, round(max(value), 2) AS max_ms, count(*) AS samples FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND metric_name IN ('system.actions_duration_ms', 'game.match.duration_ms', 'phx.client.action_latency_ms') GROUP BY metric_name ORDER BY avg_ms DESC

panels.title: Match outcomes and duration
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minute') AS time, metric_name, sum(value) AS matches FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND metric_name IN ('game.match.outcomes', 'game.match.duration_ms', 'game.match.turns') GROUP BY time, metric_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Feature adoption
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minute') AS time, feature, event, sum(value) AS events FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND metric_name IN ('game.feature.events', 'phx.client.feature_events') GROUP BY time, feature, event ORDER BY time

panels.title: SLO budget burn
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minute') AS time, slo, operation, sum(value) AS violations FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND metric_name = 'slo.violations' GROUP BY time, slo, operation ORDER BY time

panels.title: Browser experience · Web Vitals and action ACK
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, metric_name, name, round(avg(value), 2) AS value FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND metric_name IN ('phx.client.web_vitals', 'phx.client.action_latency_ms') GROUP BY time, metric_name, name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Dependency latency · Postgres and external calls
panels.query: SELECT peer_service, db_operation, round(avg(duration_ms), 2) AS avg_ms, round(max(duration_ms), 2) AS max_ms, count(*) AS calls FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND (peer_service IS NOT NULL OR db_operation IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY peer_service, db_operation ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Uptime and saturation
panels.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, metric_name, max(value) AS value FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND metric_name IN ('system.process_uptime_seconds', 'system.matches_active', 'system.ws_connections') GROUP BY time, metric_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recent Phalanx errors
panels.query: SELECT _timestamp, service_name, span_name, error_type, message, trace_id FROM default WHERE service_namespace = 'phalanxduel' AND (status_code = 'ERROR' OR level = 'error') ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

notes: The service map is derived from actual spans and peer.service relationships, not a hand-drawn topology claim.
Match IDs, session IDs, and QA run IDs belong in trace drill-downs. Keep them out of metric group-by clauses.
OpenObserve may use generated field names for OTLP metric points. If a panel is empty, inspect one metric record and map its generated field names without changing the scope filter.
